mn15:6.1: tatrāvuso bhikkhunā attanāva attānaṃ evaṃ anuminitabbaṃ:
mn15:6.2: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo pāpiccho pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo.
mn15:6.3: ahañceva kho panassaṃ pāpiccho pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti.
mn15:6.4: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā na pāpiccho bhavissāmi na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatoti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.5: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo attukkaṃsako paravambhī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo.
mn15:6.6: ahañceva kho panassaṃ attukkaṃsako paravambhī, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti.
mn15:6.7: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā ‘anattukkaṃsako bhavissāmi aparavambhī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.8: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo kodhano kodhābhibhūto, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo.
mn15:6.9: ahañceva kho panassaṃ kodhano kodhābhibhūto, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti.
mn15:6.10: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā, ‘na kodhano bhavissāmi na kodhābhibhūto’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.11: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo kodhano kodhahetu upanāhī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo.
mn15:6.12: ahañceva kho panassaṃ kodhano kodhahetu upanāhī, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti.
mn15:6.13: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā ‘na kodhano bhavissāmi na kodhahetu upanāhī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.14: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo kodhano kodhahetu abhisaṅgī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo.
mn15:6.15: ahañceva kho panassaṃ kodhano kodhahetu abhisaṅgī, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti.
mn15:6.16: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā ‘na kodhano bhavissāmi na kodhahetu abhisaṅgī’ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.17: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo kodhano kodhasāmantā vācaṃ nicchāretā, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
mn15:6.18: ahañceva kho panassaṃ kodhano kodhasāmantā vācaṃ nicchāretā, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti.
mn15:6.19: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā “na kodhano bhavissāmi. na kodhasāmantā vācaṃ nicchāressāmī”ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.20: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo cudito codakena paṭippharati, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
mn15:6.21: ahañceva kho pana cudito codakena codakaṃ paṭipphareyyaṃ, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti.
mn15:6.22: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā ‘cudito codakena codakaṃ na paṭippharissāmī”ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.23: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo cudito codakena codakaṃ apasādeti, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
mn15:6.24: ahañceva kho pana cudito codakena codakaṃ apasādeyyaṃ, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti.
mn15:6.25: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā “cudito codakena codakaṃ na apasādessāmī”ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.26: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo cudito codakena codakassa paccāropeti, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
mn15:6.27: ahañceva kho pana cudito codakena codakassa paccāropeyyaṃ, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti.
mn15:6.28: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā “cudito codakena codakassa na paccāropessāmī”ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.29: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo cudito codakena aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
mn15:6.30: ahañceva kho pana cudito codakena aññenaññaṃ paṭicareyyaṃ bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeyyaṃ kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukareyyaṃ, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti.
mn15:6.31: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā “cudito codakena na aññenaññaṃ paṭicarissāmi. na bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmessāmi. na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukarissāmī”ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.32: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo cudito codakena apadāne na sampāyati, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo.
mn15:6.33: ahañceva kho pana cudito codakena apadāne na sampāyeyyaṃ, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti
mn15:6.34: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā “cudito codakena apadāne sampāyissāmī”ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.35: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo makkhī paḷāsī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
mn15:6.36: ahañceva kho panassaṃ makkhī paḷāsī, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti
mn15:6.37: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā “amakkhī bhavissāmi apaḷāsī”ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.38: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo issukī maccharī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo;
mn15:6.39: ahañceva kho panassaṃ issukī maccharī, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti
mn15:6.40: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā “anissukī bhavissāmi amaccharī”ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.41: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo saṭho māyāvī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo.
mn15:6.42: ahañceva kho panassaṃ saṭho māyāvī ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti
mn15:6.43: evaṃ jānantenāvuso bhikkhunā “asaṭho bhavissāmi amāyāvī”ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.44: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo thaddho atimānī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo.
mn15:6.45: ahañceva kho panassaṃ thaddho atimānī, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti.
mn15:6.46: evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā “atthaddho bhavissāmi anatimānī”ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:6.47: “yo khvāyaṃ puggalo sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī ādhānagāhī duppaṭinissaggī, ayaṃ me puggalo appiyo amanāpo.
mn15:6.48: ahañceva kho panassaṃ sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī ādhānagāhī duppaṭinissaggī, ahampassaṃ paresaṃ appiyo amanāpo”ti
mn15:6.49: evaṃ jānantenāvuso, bhikkhunā “asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī bhavissāmi anādhānagāhī suppaṭinissaggī”ti cittaṃ uppādetabbaṃ.
mn15:7.1: tatrāvuso bhikkhunā attanāva attānaṃ evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
mn15:7.2: “kinnu khomhi pāpiccho pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato”ti.

mn15:7.4: “pāpiccho khomhi pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gato”ti. tenāvuso bhikkhunā tesaṃ yeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.

mn15:7.50: “cudito khomhi codakena codakassa na paccāropemī”ti, tenāvuso bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.

mn15:7.52: “kinnu khomhi cudito codakena aññenaññaṃ paṭicarāmi, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmemi, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaromī”ti.
mn15:7.53: sace āvuso bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
mn15:7.54: “cudito khomhi codakena aññenaññaṃ paṭicarāmi, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmemi, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaromī”ti, tenāvuso bhikkhunā tesaṃ yeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
mn15:7.55: sace panāvuso bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
mn15:7.56: “cudito khomhi codakena na aññenaññaṃ paṭicarāmi. na bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmemi. na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaromī”ti, tenāvuso bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
mn15:7.57: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhunā attanāva attānaṃ evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
mn15:7.58: “kinnu khomhi cudito codakena apadāne na sampāyāmī”ti.
mn15:7.59: sace āvuso bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
mn15:7.60: “cudito khomhi codakena apadāne na sampāyāmī”ti, tenāvuso, bhikkhunā tesaṃ yeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.

mn15:8.1: sace āvuso bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno sabbepime pāpake akusale dhamme appahīne attani samanupassati, tenāvuso bhikkhunā sabbesaṃ yeva imesaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
mn15:8.2: sace panāvuso bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno sabbepime pāpake akusale dhamme pahīne attani samanupassati, tenāvuso bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
mn15:8.3: seyyathāpi āvuso itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ādāse vā pariyodāte acche vā udapatte sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno sace tattha passati rajaṃ vā aṅgaṇaṃ vā, tasseva rajassa vā aṅgaṇassa vā pahānāya vāyamati.
mn15:8.4: no ce tattha passati rajaṃ vā aṅgaṇaṃ vā teneva attamano hoti:
mn15:8.6: evameva kho āvuso sace bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno sabbepime pāpake akusale dhamme appahīne attani samanupassati, tenāvuso bhikkhunā sabbesaṃyeva imesaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ.
mn15:8.7: sace panāvuso bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno sabbepime pāpake akusale dhamme pahīne attani samanupassati, tenāvuso bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesūti.
mn15:8.9: attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
